This page surfaces the formal critique files that accompany the AffineDrift theory articles. These critiques document identified weaknesses, boundary conditions, and counterarguments to the core control-affine golf swing framework. They are published for transparency and to support rigorous engagement with the work.

::: {.callout-note}
## Status
These are working documents, not peer-reviewed assessments. Some critiques have been incorporated into the main articles as scope limitations or caveats. Where a critique identifies an unresolved issue, the main article should note it.
:::

## Core Framework Critiques

### Muscle Physiology and Biological Realism

- **[The Fallacy of Passive Drift and the Skeletal Baseline](01_muscle_physiology.html)** — Co-contraction, tone, and the affine model
- **[Flaccid Drift Contradiction](flaccid_drift_contradiction.html)** — Inconsistency between "zero torque" baseline and physiological reality
- **[The Effective Plant Fallacy](the_effective_plant_fallacy.html)** — Critique of the "Frozen Strategy" assumption
- **[Stretch-Shortening Cycle Blindspot](stretch_shortening_blindspot.html)** — Elastic energy storage not captured in the model

### ZTCF and Counterfactual Framework

- **[ZTCF Identifiability](ztcf_identifiability.html)** — Fundamental observability limitations of the zero-torque counterfactual
- **[Passive/Active Boundary Ambiguity](passive_active_boundary_ambiguity.html)** — Where drift ends and control begins
- **[Static Fallacy of ZVCF](static_fallacy_zvcf.html)** — Limitations of the zero-velocity counterfactual
- **[Passive Overshoot Artifact](passive_overshoot_artifact.html)** — Artifacts from ZTCF trajectory divergence
- **[Causal Masking in Drift Superposition](drift_superposition.html)** — Velocity-dependent drift terms are consequences of prior inputs; labeling them "passive" obscures energetic history

### Drift-Control Ratio (DCR)

- **[Dimensional Inconsistency of DCR](dimensional_inconsistency_dcr.html)** — Unit issues in the drift-control ratio
- **[Planar DCR Blindness](planar_dcr_blindness.html)** — DCR misses axial control authority
- **[Normative Ambiguity of Drift](normative_ambiguity_drift.html)** — What does "drift dominance" actually mean?
- **[Precision vs. Gross Control](precision_vs_gross_control.html)** — DCR conflates inability to reverse the swing with inability to adjust impact parameters by fine margins

### Accessibility and Controllability

- **[Lie Bracket Formalism Overreach](lie_bracket_formalism_overreach.html)** — LARC claims exceed what Lie brackets prove
- **[Sequencing and Lie Brackets](sequencing_lie_bracket_fallacy.html)** — Lie brackets cannot explain distal-to-proximal sequencing causality

### Impact and Constraint
